description: Source code implementing IPv6 Multicast Listener Discovery (MLD) functions, including joining/leaving multicast groups, sending MLD reports, and handling MLD queries within the Zephyr OS network stack.

methods.name: mld_create
methods.description: Creates an MLD multicast record in a packet with specified address, record type, and source count.

methods.name: mld_create_packet
methods.description: Constructs an MLDv2 packet with specified source count, setting IPv6 destination and options.

methods.name: mld_send
methods.description: Finalizes and sends the constructed MLD packet, updating statistics.

methods.name: mld_send_generic
methods.description: Creates and sends a generic MLD message (join/leave) for a given interface and address.

methods.name: net_ipv6_mld_join
methods.description: Joins an IPv6 multicast group using MLD on a specified interface.

methods.name: net_ipv6_mld_leave
methods.description: Leaves an IPv6 multicast group using MLD on a specified interface.

methods.name: send_mld_report
methods.description: Sends an MLD report for all joined multicast addresses on an interface.

methods.name: handle_mld_query
methods.description: Handles incoming MLD query messages, responding with reports if appropriate.

methods.name: net_ipv6_mld_init
methods.description: Initializes the MLD handling context and registers the query handler.
